slides.prompt: Create one photorealistic professional fashion or product campaign photograph. Use supplied product reference image(s), if available. Preserve frame geometry, bridge fit, temple placement and lens tint; reflections must not hide the product. Brand/art direction: Refined, realistic fashion photography. Keep the hero product clearly readable, naturally fitted or held, with realistic scale, folds, contact shadows and anatomy. Use discreet supporting styling only when needed; never obscure or replace the hero product. Render the stated location and lighting coherently. Preserve natural skin and material texture. No invented branding, extra products, duplicated limbs, captions, watermarks or excessive retouching. When a full-body view is requested, include the entire head and feet with breathing room. Keep the chosen model anatomically natural. Vary the model, product, pose, setting, camera and lighting as specified in the brief.

slides.prompt: Create one photorealistic campaign photograph, not a grid. Input: ONLY the user's uploaded product reference. Campaign route: Clean product. Creative concept: Precise commercial product photography: six distinct viewpoints reveal form, texture and actual features. Example art direction: Neutral warm-white seamless studio, soft side key, subtle fill, clean product separation and physically realistic contact shadows. Example palette: warm white and true product colors. Derive the final colors, casting, styling and set from the supplied product. No separate outfit, model or location input is required. Product-only board. No model or person in any panel. Preserve the product reference's exact design, color, material, geometry, construction, size, packaging and visible branding. Inspect actual curved band, inner surface, polish and real construction; use only features visible or stated in the supplied product. Adapt any shot involving a pump, cap, cuff, sleeve, strap, container, animal or ingredient to what actually exists; do not invent absent features, accessory products, ingredients, performance claims or internal mechanisms. Example colors and materials are creative cues: substitute the supplied product's true characteristics. Keep skin, fur, hands, fabric behavior, scale, physical contacts, reflections and shadows plausible. No captions, panel numbers, invented logos, watermark or screenshot UI. Shot R1C1: Product hero. Action: Show the complete hero product in its natural presentation with realistic contact shadow. Camera: eye-level front. Framing: product-only full view. Where a subject is present, reuse the campaign's internally generated hero for face, animal and styling continuity. Product-only framing contains no human or animal. Full-body framing includes complete head and feet; full-animal framing includes complete head, tail and paws.
